title: F&F Properties
description:
At F&F Properties, we love San Diego County just as much as you do. That’s why we offer a wide selection of apartments in a variety of floor plans and neighborhoods.

We professionally manage our own properties with a well-trained, knowledgeable, and local team. We’re dedicated to the satisfaction of our residents and want our resident experience to be A+.

Do the Right Thing, Plus One

It’s not just a slogan. It’s how we live. It means we’re in a constant pursuit to take initiative and show integrity, honesty, and transparency.

We love what we do

We focus on creating unique communities where residents thrive and are proud to call home. Focusing on individual neighborhoods, we acquire, renovate, and build properties that speak for themselves.

With 30+ apartment communities consisting of 500+ apartment homes in 18 neighborhoods (and growing every single day), we’re proud to own and operate quality housing in San Diego.

jobs.title: Sales Team Manager
jobs.description:
Apartment Leasing Division

F&F Properties  |  San Diego, CA  |  Full-time, Exempt  |  Reports to Director of Operations

Total compensation up to $150,000/yr  ($80K–$100K base DOQ + bonus opportunity up to 50% of base)

THE GIG

Own the funnel. Lead the pack. Fill the units.

Got a pulse for people, a nose for stalled leads, and a track record of turning sales teams into top performers? We're not looking for a leasing agent who has managed a few people—we're looking for a proven sales leader who knows how to motivate a team, own a revenue target, and deliver results across a portfolio.

Real estate experience isn't required. Sales leadership is. If you know how to build accountability, drive performance, and hit the number, we'll teach you the leasing side. You'll lead a high-impact team of fewer than 10 — inside sales (appointment setters), outside sales (roving leasing agents), and the support staff who keep it all moving — running the full sales engine behind a 40+ property portfolio across San Diego County that needs to stay full. Your north star: crushing average days vacant. Your playground: every stage of the funnel, from first lead score to signed lease to the resident's long-term value.

This isn't a “watch the dashboard” job. You'll jump in on tours yourself when the team needs backup, coach agents in real time, and hunt down every stalled deal before it goes cold.

This role was designed with transferable talent in mind. We’re especially interested in accomplished sales leaders from outside property management who bring fresh thinking, strong sales discipline, and a history of hitting ambitious targets.

Strong sales management backgrounds from hospitality, automotive and powersports, mortgage, insurance, luxury retail, home services, customer service, and other high-touch sales environments often transition well into this role — what matters most is that you can lead a sales team to results, not which industry you learned it in.

You're joining a winning team, and we want the best of the best. We win a lot here, and we believe in smart growth, not growth for its own sake. We don’t open this seat often, and we’re not looking to simply fill it—we’re looking for the right leader to own it.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Team Scheduling & Operations

•     Own the daily tour schedule — batch routes geographically, kill drive-time waste, maximize quality tours per agent

•     Spot schedule gaps, no-show patterns, and inefficiencies before they become a problem

•     Jump into tours yourself when coverage is tight

•     Sync with property managers & maintenance on unit readiness and show-ability

Recruiting, Onboarding & Training

•     Recruit leasing agent talent and weigh in on hiring calls

•     Own onboarding — property knowledge, CRM, tour protocol, company standards

•     Build and maintain scripts, objection-handling guides, and training materials

•     Run ongoing training based on real performance data and call reviews

Coaching & Quality Control

•     Shadow agents on tours; give real-time, real-talk feedback

•     Review calls for lead handling, follow-up quality, and script adherence

•     Run weekly team meetings + 1:1s that move the needle on KPIs

•     Audit CRM notes and hold the team accountable to documentation standards

•     Flag performance issues fast and escalate when it's time for formal action

Lead Management & Pipeline Accountability

•     Score leads daily and drive urgency on the hottest prospects

•     Track follow-up cadence and step in the moment it slips

•     Chase stalled tours, unfinished applications, and gone-cold prospects

•     Cross-promote leads across F&F's portfolio — nobody goes cold on your watch

•     Hunt down late paperwork and deposits until the lease is signed

Performance Management & Reporting

•     Set and manage team quotas that ladder up to broader business objectives, not just individual targets

•     Track KPIs daily: tours, conversion rates at every funnel stage, days vacant

•     Build intervention plans for agents/properties off target, when necessary

•     Deliver weekly field intel to Asset Management: objections, pricing, competitive landscape

Cross-Functional Partnership

•     Partner with the Marketing team on lead flow, campaign feedback, and market positioning

•     Partner with Property Management on unit readiness, resident experience, and turn timing

•     Partner with Asset Management on absorption targets, pricing strategy, and portfolio performance

Lease-Up Coordination

•     Be the go-to contact for lease-up properties — partner with Asset Management on absorption targets

•     Build property-specific leasing strategies for lease-ups

•     Keep agents sharp on lease-up units, amenities, pricing, and concessions

jobs.benefitsSection:
THE COMPENSATION AND PERKS

•     $80K–$100K base salary DOQ + bonus opportunity up to 50% of base (total compensation up to $150,000/yr)

•     401(k) with a strong 50% company match up to 6%, after 1,000 hours

•     Medical / Dental / Vision after 30 days

•     $500/month off rent at an eligible F&F property after 60 days

•     Vacation pay: 80 hours/year, accrued each pay period

•     40 hours sick pay/year

•     8 paid holidays

•     $50/month phone reimbursement

•     Mileage reimbursement at the current IRS rate

INSIDE F&F

F&F Properties is a San Diego-based, fully integrated real estate investment company with a portfolio valued at over half a billion dollars — one of the top 25 apartment operators in San Diego County, with a 40+ property portfolio on track to surpass 1,300 units as current lease-up and construction projects are completed and growing faster than 90% of the industry. We acquire, develop, renovate, and professionally manage boutique apartment communities throughout San Diego County, creating high-quality homes in the neighborhoods people want to call home.

F&F was founded in 2011 by Dan Feder — An entrepreneur who had already successfully built and sold his first company recognized a significant gap in the market: quality rental housing for San Diego's workforce. Dan grew that first venture from a startup to 250+ employees, earning three INC 500 rankings and the USC Greif Center's Entrepreneur of the Year award, before turning his full attention to solving San Diego's housing gap. That same entrepreneurial drive — and a belief in smart, disciplined growth over growth for its own sake — still shapes F&F today. We're a smart-growth company built to last, with a steady upward trajectory over 15 years. We compete to win, and we win a lot. Winners want to work with winners—and the right people see themselves as part of that equation.

Our work goes beyond providing housing. With an experienced local team managing the communities we own, we're committed to delivering an exceptional resident experience while thoughtfully investing in our properties and strengthening the communities we serve.

Our commitment extends well beyond the communities we own and manage. Giving back is an important part of who we are. F&F and our team proudly support organizations throughout San Diego, including Rady Children's Hospital, the San Diego Humane Society, Just in Time for Foster Youth, the Chula Vista Police Foundation, and other local organizations dedicated to health, education, and strengthening families.

That spirit of service starts at the top. Our founder and his family are personally committed to giving back as well, supporting organizations such as Friends of the IDF and Father Joe's Villages.

F&F is also a recognized voice in the San Diego business and real estate community. Our leadership sits on the board of the Chamber of Commerce and is active in the Lincoln Club, and we're regularly invited to speak at industry events as go-to experts on multifamily investment and development in San Diego County.

Our projects and contributions have been recognized by organizations and local leaders throughout the region, including:

•     BIA (Building Industry Association of San Diego) Infill Project of the Year — 2025

•     County of San Diego Recognition from County Assessor Jordan M. Marks for Le Jaime and Duplet — 2025

•     San Diego Regional Chamber of Commerce Recognition for Le Jaime

•     Mayoral Certificate of Recognition from Chula Vista Mayor John McCann for The Adelaide — 2026

•     Imperial Beach Chamber of Commerce Recognition for The Crest — 2026

At the center of everything we do is a simple purpose: Improving the Quality and Quantity of San Diego's Housing Supply.

OUR CORE VALUES (a.k.a. HOW WE ROLL)

3D Customer Focus — Investors, Residents, Fellow Employees. Do the right thing, plus 1.

Fueled by Results — Be in it to win it. Own it. Best in class.

Urgent Attention to Consistency & Detail — Get it right, every time.

Do the Necessary When Necessary — Work hard when it counts, recharge when it doesn't.

Communicate with Purpose — Honest, forthright, to the point.

Ready to own the funnel? Apply today

https://www.fandfinc.com/careers/

jobs.requirementsSection:
WHAT YOU BRING

Real estate or leasing experience is not required for this role. In fact, we welcome candidates from outside the industry who bring strong sales leadership experience and a fresh perspective. We will fully train the right person on property operations, leasing processes, and our CRM systems. What matters most is your ability to lead a sales team, drive performance, and deliver results.

The profile: A proven sales leader with 3+ years of experience managing a team and owning a revenue target in a high-touch, quota-driven environment. Your background might be in automotive, home services, vacation ownership, insurance, mortgage, financial services, luxury retail, hospitality—or another performance-driven sales industry.

You are a leader first - someone who takes as much pride in the team's success as your own. You know your numbers, live in the metrics, coach effectively one-on-one, and hold people accountable for results. But you are not afraid to jump into the action either—whether that means picking up the phone, walking a tour, helping close a deal, or bringing the confidence and urgency needed to get a stalled opportunity moving.

You know how to lead from the front, drive the numbers, and build a team that wins.

•     3+ years of direct people-management experience — you've run a team, not just carried your own number — in a hands-on, quota-driven sales environment (auto, retail, hospitality, insurance, financial services, home services, or similar)

•     Real full-cycle lead management experience — first contact through close — and the instinct to keep pushing until every lead is either won or truly dead

•     Experience setting and managing team quotas that ladder up to broader business objectives, not just personal numbers

•     Experience managing a full sales operation together — outside sales, inside sales, and the support staff who make the engine run — not just one piece of it

•     Comfortable working cross-functionally — with Marketing, Property Management, and Asset Management — to keep the whole operation aligned

•     Real understanding of the full sales funnel and customer lifetime value — you know the job isn't finished the moment a deal closes

•     Fluency with a CRM or sales-tracking platform, and comfortable working within established systems and processes — plus the ability to train others and enforce standards

•     A true team player who can manage a moving schedule across multiple sites and keep everyone rowing in the same direction

•     Strong communicator and problem-solver, with real experience de-escalating upset customers, a sense of urgency, and the ability to pivot fast when the plan changes

•     Exceptional communication skills, with the confidence to deliver candid feedback and navigate difficult conversations clearly and professionally. A sharp eye for the numbers—the ability to spot what's off, get to the root of it, and turn performance around fast.

•     Valid CA driver's license + reliable wheels

jobs.title: Onsite Resident Manager - Part-time : Paradise Hills & Imperial Beach
jobs.description:
CURRENT OPENINGS

F&F Property Management, Inc. is actively accepting applications for current and future Onsite Resident Manager opportunities within our growing portfolio of owner-operated multifamily communities in San Diego County.

Current Opportunities:

Arroyo Vista – 475 S. Meadowbrook Drive, San Diego, CA 92114 $17.75 per hour - part-time

The Crest 1031 Imperial Beach Blvd, Imperial Beach, CA 91932 $16.90 per hour - part-time


Current openings may vary. Qualified applicants may also be considered for future opportunities at other F&F communities throughout San Diego County.

Compensation: minimum wage
Benefit: 1/3 Discount Off Market Rent on select units
Schedule: Approximately 5–10 Hours Per Week

POSITION SUMMARY

F&F Property Management, Inc. is seeking experienced and dependable Onsite Resident Managers to serve as the eyes and ears of our communities. This position plays an important role in maintaining the appearance, safety, and overall condition of the property while providing timely communication and support to management.

The ideal candidate has previous experience serving as an onsite manager, resident manager, apartment manager, onsite representative, or in a similar property management role and can provide professional references verifying their performance and reliability.

This is a live-on-site position and candidates must be able to satisfy all requirements associated with onsite housing arrangements.

Department: Property Management
Reports To: Senior Property Manager
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Conduct routine property walks and report maintenance concerns, property damage, bulk items, safety hazards, and policy violations.
Inspect common areas, laundry facilities, walkways, stairwells, parking areas, and amenity spaces to ensure cleanliness and proper condition.
Monitor parking areas and report unauthorized vehicles, abandoned vehicles, and safety concerns.
Observe and report vandalism, lighting outages, trip hazards, security concerns, and suspicious activity.
Communicate resident concerns, lease violations, maintenance issues, and property-related observations to management.
Document concerns through photographs and written reports when requested.
Submit maintenance requests and assist with follow-up as directed.
Provide courteous and professional interactions with residents, vendors, and visitors.
Assist with community communication and resident relations as needed.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.

jobs.title: Leasing Consultant - High Performance Sales
jobs.description:
Closers Wanted

If you are used to working showroom traffic, building relationships face-to-face, and confidently closing deals, this role will feel familiar.

This is not a traditional leasing role. This is a sales-driven opportunity designed for professionals who thrive in fast-paced, performance-focused environments and want strong earning potential backed by consistent inbound traffic.

At F&F Properties, we provide the leads, systems, support, and structure. We’re looking for motivated professionals who are competitive, disciplined, relationship-focused, and driven by results.

Candidates with a background in sales from hospitality, automotive and powersports, real estate, mortgage, insurance, luxury retail, customer service, and other high-touch sales environments often transition well into this role.

Position Summary

The Leasing Consultant I is responsible for managing the full leasing cycle, from initial prospect engagement through move-in. This role focuses heavily on relationship-building, follow-up, overcoming objections, conducting tours, and closing leases while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

This position requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, professionalism, urgency, and the ability to effectively manage a high-volume pipeline using CRM and property management systems.

What Makes Someone Successful in this Role

You may be a great fit if you:

Love closing the deal

Thrive in a competitive, goal-oriented environment

Enjoy face-to-face interaction and relationship-building

Are self-motivated and productive without constant oversight

Bring urgency, consistency, and accountability to your work

Can confidently handle objections and difficult conversations

Stay organized while managing multiple prospects and follow-ups

Are motivated by performance-based compensation and career growth
